mapper.select: SELECT p.*, c.company_name, cl.client_name, (SELECT q.quote_status FROM quotes q WHERE q.project_id = p.project_id ORDER BY q.quote_date DESC, q.quote_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_quote_status, (SELECT q.deadline_date FROM quotes q WHERE q.project_id = p.project_id ORDER BY q.quote_date DESC, q.quote_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS deadline_date FROM projects p LEFT JOIN companies c ON p.company_id = c.company_id LEFT JOIN clients cl ON p.client_id = cl.client_id ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC
select p.*, cl.client_name, c.company_name from projects p left join clients cl on p.client_id = cl.client_id left join companies c on p.company_id = c.company_id where p.project_id = #{id}
